title: Protocol for isolation of spermatids from mouse testes
protocol: Sacrifice mice using isoflurane inhalation in the closed chamber.
Open the lower abdomen using surgical scissors.
Expose testes by pulling epididymal fat.
Remove epididymal fat and epidymis around testes.
Transfer testes to cold DPBS.
Wash blood off testes.
Remove tunica albuginea of testes.
Transfer tunica albuginea-removed testes to digestion media I.
Reconstitute mouse testes in digestion media I.
Incubate the testes for 15 minutes to dissociate seminiferous tubules.
Pour the digested product over a 5% Percoll solution at 20°C–25°C.
Incubate for 20 minutes, allowing high-density seminiferous tubules to sink to the bottom.
Load the digested product into digestion media II.
Incubate for an additional 15 minutes and gently pipette until seminiferous tubules are fully dissociated.
Remove 35 mL of supernatant from the Percoll solution.
Transfer 5 mL containing seminiferous tubules to fresh digestion media II (10 mL).
Perform secondary digestion at 37°C for 20 minutes, carefully pipetting until seminiferous tubules disappear.
Add FBS 3 mL to neutralize trypsin.
Filter the digested product through a 70 μm cell strainer followed by a 40 μm cell strainer sequentially.
Centrifuge the filtered cell suspension with 500 × g at 4°C for 10 minutes.
Pipette the cell pellet with 1 mL of HBSS (1×) and centrifuge it with 500 × g at 4°C for 2 minutes.
Pipette the cell pellet with 1 mL of RBC lysis buffer (1×, diluted with distilled water) and incubate at 4°C for 1 minute.
Centrifuge the cells with 500 × g at 4°C for 2 minutes.
Critical: Keep the time for this step. Too long an incubation can damage testicular cells.
Pipette the cell pellet with 1 mL of HBSS (1×) and centrifuge it with 500 × g at 4°C for 2 minutes.
Pipette the cells with 1 mL of 0.5% BSA.
Load testicular cells in 1 mL of 0.5% BSA to the wall of the column slowly over 0.5% BSA using serological pipettes.
Stand the loaded cells for 150 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Open the valve at the bottom of the column so that the flow rate is 2 mL/min and collect fractions per 4 mL.
Centrifuge all collected fractions with 1,000 × g at 4°C for 10 minutes.
Discard the supernatant and pipette cell pellets with 1 mL of HBSS (1×).
Observe cells in each fraction under a microscope.
Following centrifugation with 1,000 × g at 4°C for 3 minutes, store the cell pellet at −80°C.
